output.reason: [ev-875bb56564b0] and the rest of the Changed Metrics section ([ev-2e2ab2d37845], [ev-1bf87d491deb]) only say that the metric was renamed. They don't say whether the old name stops being exported, is kept as an alias, or what happens to dashboards and alerts that query it. The proposed "setting-ignored" also doesn't fit: an exported metric name is not a configured value that stops being honoured. Choosing a mandatory-work kind would claim more than the evidence supports, so we need upstream text that says what happens to consumers of lbipam_ips_available_total (for example, that the old series is no longer emitted).
